content_zh:
龙飞正在研究系统的时候，一名丫鬟打扮的少女行色匆匆走进屋，看到坐在床沿上的龙飞震住了。
瓜子脸，柳叶眉，眼睛就像泉水清澈，透着灵气，身穿更是黄金比例，只因年龄还小发育没有全面，只要再给她几年绝对是倾国倾城的大美女。
丫鬟名叫乔乔。
是太爷偶然一次外出捡回来的，因为龙飞父母失踪，性格有些孤僻，就让乔乔陪着龙飞。
两人从小一起长大。
龙飞还是天才的时候，她默默无闻，龙飞血脉被抽离，丹田破碎，被家族贬到山下茅草屋中，她一直跟随，全心全意的照顾龙飞。
这一年里，如果没有乔乔的照顾，龙飞早就死了。
龙飞心存感激，虽然他不是以前的龙飞，可是记忆中那些片段告诉他，这个丫头是这个世界上真正对自己好的人。
为数不多的人之一。
也算是他在这异界唯一的亲人。
对于亲人，龙飞有一种莫名的奢望，前世他是孤儿，从小就没有父母，身边一个亲人都没有，现在他身边有亲人，他会拼命珍惜。
龙飞轻轻点了点头，“嗯。”
就在这时候。
“哐当！”
院子里的门被一脚踢飞。
“乔乔，今天是最后期限，我看你还能往哪里躲！”一道粗狂的声音响起。
房间内。
乔乔脸色一凛，吓得颤抖了起来。
龙飞眉心一皱，听着声音有些耳熟，“李三？”
龙家众多杂务管事中的一位。

乔乔点点头，“他是来收账的。”
“收账？”龙飞对这些事情并不了解，对于生活上的事情他从来没有关心过，一直是乔乔料理。不过，据他所知，这李三极度好色，贪恋乔乔的美色不是一天两天的事情。
乔乔低声说道：“几天前你被龙傲打昏迷，我找他借钱买了药给你医治，本来是说三个月后换钱的，可是不知道为什么借条上变成三天，今天是最后的期限。”
“还不给我滚出来？”李三的声音在院子内再次响起，淫笑起来，道：“只要你答应陪我一晚上，钱的事情好说。”
“当然。”
“你以后跟我也可以，跟着我吃香喝辣的，比你跟着那个废物少爷要强的多，乔乔，我这是在给你机会，别不识抬举，以前龙飞是天才还能罩着你，现在他是废物，给龙家蒙羞的废物，龙家上下都巴不得他早点去死，你跟着他只会受累，跟着我，我一定会好好疼惜你的。”
“哈哈哈……”
龙飞顿时就怒了。
一个小小的杂务管事都敢欺负到他的头上来了。
“妈的！”
龙飞怒骂一声，立刻冲出房间，道：“李三，我看你是活腻了，一个小小的下人连我龙飞的人都敢欺负。”
李三一愣，微微一惊，随即冷笑一声，道：“呦呵，还当自己是龙家大天才呢？你现在不过是废物，丹田破碎的废物，你现在算个什么东西啊，也不撒泡尿好好照照自己什么德行，哼！”
完全不把龙飞放在眼里。
在龙家，没有人把龙飞放在眼里。
因为他是丹田破碎，永远无法翻身的废材。
“咯咯……”
龙飞双拳紧握，牙齿咬的咯咯爆响。
李三嘲笑道：“发怒了，我好怕怕哦，来啊，来打我啊，看你这废物能不能碰到我的衣角。”
乔乔立即拉住龙飞摇着头，道：“少爷，他是一级战士，修为在你之上，不能跟他打。”
一级战士就如此嚣张？

因为龙飞是零级，也就是没有等级。
根本不是李三的对手。
所以他才嚣张。
李三大声嘲笑道：“怎么了？怕了？不敢来啊，就你这废物老子一只手都能弄死你，还敢在我面前嚣张，哼，不自量力。”
怒火在翻滚。
被人欺负到这种程度，龙飞忍不住。
“乔乔，还钱的时间到了，今天要么还钱，要么陪我一晚上，否则的话，我的手段你是知道的，当然我不会打你，你这么娇滴滴的小美人我怎么舍得打，不过这位废物龙飞嘛，嘿嘿……”李三盯着乔乔娇滴滴的小脸蛋浮想翩翩起来。
乔乔看了龙飞一眼，最后踏出一步。
就在这时候。
龙飞一把拉住乔乔，微微道：“只要有我在，这个世界上没有人能欺负你。”
龙飞一步踏出，走到屋檐下，对着一只刚才洞里爬出来，头上还顶着一条血槽的癞蛤蟆一脚踩了下去。
“吧唧！”
“呱！”
癞蛤蟆发出一声惨叫，内脏都被踩爆出来了。

content_en:
While Long Fei was studying the system, a girl dressed as a maid hurried into the room and was shocked to see Long Fei sitting on the edge of the bed.
She has a face with oval seeds, eyebrows with willow leaves, eyes as clear as spring water, full of aura, and her clothes are in golden proportions. Because she is still young and not fully developed, as long as she is given a few more years, she will definitely be a beauty that will captivate the entire country.
The maid's name is Qiao Qiao.
The grandfather accidentally picked it up when he went out. Because Long Fei's parents were missing and his personality was somewhat withdrawn, he asked Qiao Qiao to accompany Long Fei.
The two grew up together.
When Long Fei was still a genius, she was unknown. Long Fei's bloodline was taken away, his Dantian was broken, and he was demoted to a thatched house at the foot of the mountain by his family. She followed him and took care of Long Fei wholeheartedly.
In this year, without Qiao Qiao's care, Long Fei would have died long ago.
Long Fei was grateful. Although he was not the Long Fei before, the fragments in his memory told him that this girl was the one who truly treated him well in the world.
One of the few.
It can be regarded as his only relative in this other world.
Long Fei has an inexplicable extravagant desire for his relatives. In his previous life, he was an orphan. He had no parents since he was a child, and he had no relatives around him. Now that he has relatives around him, he will cherish them desperately.
Long Fei nodded slightly, "Yes."
That's when.
"Clang!"
The door to the yard was kicked open.
"Qiaoqiao, today is the deadline, let me see where else you can hide!" A rough voice sounded.
inside the room.
Qiaoqiao's face turned stern and she started to tremble with fear.
Long Fei frowned, and the voice sounded familiar, "Li San?"
One of the many chore managers of the Long family.
Qiaoqiao nodded, "He's here to collect the bill."
"Collect the bill?" Long Fei didn't know much about these things. He had never cared about life matters and had always been Qiao Qiao's care. However, as far as he knew, Li San was extremely lustful, and his desire for Qiao Qiao's beauty was not something that happened in a day or two.
Qiao Qiao whispered: "You were beaten unconscious by Long Ao a few days ago. I asked him to borrow money to buy medicine for your treatment. It was originally said that the money would be exchanged in three months, but I don't know why the IOU changed to three days. Today is the deadline."
"Why don't you get out of here?" Li San's voice sounded again in the yard, and he smiled lewdly and said, "As long as you agree to stay with me for one night, the money matter will be easy to deal with."
"Of course."
"You can follow me in the future. You can live a good life with me. It's much better than following that good-for-nothing young master. Qiao Qiao, I'm giving you a chance. Don't be disrespectful. In the past, Long Fei was a genius and he could protect you. Now he is a good-for-nothing, a good-for-nothing who brings shame to the Long family. Everyone in the Long family wants him to die early. You will only get hurt if you follow him. Follow me and I will definitely take good care of you."
"Hahaha..."
Long Fei immediately became angry.
Even a small chore manager dared to bully him.
"Damn it!"
Long Fei cursed angrily and rushed out of the room immediately, saying: "Li San, I think you are tired of living. A small servant dares to bully even my people, Long Fei."
Li San was stunned for a moment, slightly startled, and then sneered and said: "Hey, you still think you are a great genius of the Long family? You are just a waste now, a waste with a broken Dantian. Who do you think you are now? Why don't you take a piss and look after your own virtues? Hmph!"
He didn't take Long Fei seriously at all.
In the Long family, no one took Long Fei seriously.
Because he is a loser with broken Dantian and can never turn around.
"Giggle..."
Long Fei clenched his fists tightly and gritted his teeth.
Li San laughed and said: "I'm angry. I'm so scared. Come on, come and hit me. See if you, a loser, can touch the corner of my clothes."
Qiao Qiao immediately grabbed Long Fei and shook his head, saying: "Master, he is a first-level warrior and his cultivation level is higher than yours. You cannot fight him."
Is a first-level warrior so arrogant?
Because Long Fei is zerolevel, that is, there is no level.
He is no match for Li San at all.
That's why he is arrogant.
Li San laughed loudly: "What's wrong? Are you afraid? You don't dare to come. You're a good-for-nothing and I can kill you with one hand. You still dare to be arrogant in front of me? Hmm, you don't overestimate your own abilities."
Anger boils.
Long Fei couldn't help being bullied to this extent.
"Qiao Qiao, it's time to pay back the money. Either pay back the money today or stay with me all night. Otherwise, you know my methods. Of course I won't hit you. How can I be willing to hit you, such a delicate little beauty? But this loser Long Fei, hehe..." Li San stared at Qiao Qiao's cute little face and began to think.
Qiao Qiao glanced at Long Fei and finally took a step forward.
That's when.
Long Fei grabbed Qiao Qiao and said softly: "As long as I am here, no one in this world can bully you."
Long Fei took one step forward, walked under the eaves, and stepped on a toad that had crawled out of the hole just now with a bloody groove on its head.
"Bah!"
"Quack!"
The toad let out a scream, and its internal organs were stepped on and exploded.
